About
Aurora Theatre: The Best Place to Watch Acting in Hong Kong
Aurora Theatre Hong Kong is an independent theatre company that aims to promote English-language shows among the local Hong Kong art scene. Founded by theatre performer and producer Nicole Garbellini in 2010, Aurora Hong Kong theatre company has been very active since then and has brought international and original material to the stage. The theatre is the best place to showcase acting in Hong Kong.
Video story of Aurora Theatre- Inherit the Wind and more.
Our Mission:
Aurora Theatre aims to attract different people, both familiar and unfamiliar with the local English theatre scene, and introduce them to the various shows presented by us to create a robust, valid, creative and professional art scene in Hong Kong. Aurora Theatre aims to give opportunities to those individuals who are passionate about theatre, helping them to stimulate and nurture ideas and creativity as far as performing and directing are concerned. Aurora Theatre welcomes people interested to learn drama in Hong Kong from every background, ethnicity and dialect. As we usually say, the more the variety, the better!
Our Charity Involvement:
Aurora Theatre has used its shows as fundraising to support the victims of the Japanese and Italian earthquake (in 2011, 2012 and 2016), as well as Cambodian children in need through Angel For Orphans. Through our generous supporters, Aurora Theatre has been able to raise a significant amount of funds helping the needy throughout Asia. Aurora Theatre continually looks for fundraising associations to support.
